sections.heading: D — Accuracy and Verification
sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy and Verification, Section Two License eligibility and identity

Section D records the accuracy posture for the Section Two License eligibility and identity dossier. Every knowledge fact is required to trace to its cited physical handbook page, with the cited page stating the fact. Confidence is high across the section because every rule comes from the single pinned handbook edition, and every number is spelled out in words so that the card backs read aloud exactly. The extracted text of these pages carries a font-encoding shift that garbles scattered words into offset letters and turns commas into line breaks, and two pages hold tabular document lists whose columns interleave; the dossier author decoded the shift deterministically before reading, kept each listed document inside its own list, and names forms by their descriptive titles rather than their numeric codes so that every statement reads aloud cleanly. Handbook wording is paraphrased throughout; no official sentence, table, image or question is reproduced. Fees, mailing times and document ages are stated as the pinned edition prints them; no time-variable fact beyond that edition appears, so nothing required isolation as dynamic knowledge.

corpus_stability.reason: The West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook is a periodically revised official edition, so the Section Two License eligibility and identity content changes at most with a new edition.
